notes:
Wk14 clean. Dips partial ROM painless + no pull flags → pull re-enters. Negatives in as ASSISTED PARTIALS, not full reps. No physio → the pain rule is the gate, not feel.

PAIN RULE (all days): ≤3/10 during, baseline within 24h, no added AM stiffness. Fail → drop back one step.

HARD STOP (any of these = stop pulling, get seen): clicking/catching/locking, pain at rest or at night, week-over-week worsening, numbness/tingling/weakness, a pop.

STILL OUT: full-bodyweight negatives / full pull-ups (wk17 earliest), archer / one-arm push-ups, HSPU.

Rest: 3 min main lifts, 60–90s accessories.

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.cue: Pre-injury best was 8/8/7/6; beat it with the tempo intact.
exercises.raw: Decline push-ups (feet on chair): 4×8, 3s down / 1s pause / 1s up — step 4, floor standard was clean.

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.cue: Volume up, ROM holds. Range advances wk16, not the same week negatives enter.
exercises.raw: Chair dips, PARTIAL ROM (~90°): 3×8 — volume up, ROM holds.

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.cue: Not advancing three push levers at once; hands lower wk16.
exercises.raw: Pike push-ups, hands elevated on chair: 3×5 — hold.

exercises.name: Right-arm curl
exercises.raw: Right-arm curl: 3×8, 3s/3s, 7kg — +1kg.

exercises.name: Left-arm curl
exercises.raw: Left-arm curl: 3×6, 9kg — hold.

exercises.name: Tricep extension
exercises.raw: Tricep extension: right 3×8 @7kg — +1kg. Left 3×8 @7kg — reps up, it got easier.

exercises.name: Hollow body
exercises.cue: Full position already maxed, so load is the lever.
exercises.raw: Hollow body, WEIGHTED: 3×30s, hold 0.5–1L bottles (or one 2–3kg plate) in the hands, arms overhead.

exercises.name: Zone 2 run
exercises.cue: 3:2 breathing. 6:00/km at 9 km held conversational → that's the pace. Hold both.
exercises.raw: Day 2 (Fri) — Zone 2 | 9 km @ ~6:00/km, 3:2 breathing

exercises.name: Box pistols
exercises.cue: HOLD box height — lowered box was challenging wk14, consolidate before lowering again.
exercises.raw: Box pistols: 4×5/side, bodyweight, HOLD box height.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.cue: Load holds, tempo is the lever this week.
exercises.raw: Bulgarian split squats: 4×6/side, 13kg, 3s down + 2s pause at bottom.

exercises.name: Kickstand RDL
exercises.cue: Rear toe light, ~90% front leg, flat back, stop before rounding. Any back pain → straight back to bodyweight.
exercises.raw: Kickstand RDL: 3×8/side, 5kg, 3s down — first load since the back flag.

exercises.name: Loaded high step-up
exercises.cue: REPLACES single-leg hip thrust. Backpack loads fine standing.
exercises.raw: Loaded high step-up (~knee height): 3×8/side, 13kg, 3s down — REPLACES single-leg hip thrust.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch off edge. No 15kg → 13kg + 2s stretch pause at the bottom.
exercises.raw: Single-leg calf raise, deficit: 3×8/side, 15kg, full stretch off edge.

days.notes: Order matters: pull work while fresh, curls after.

exercises.name: Scapular pulls
exercises.raw: Scapular pulls: 3×8, 2s hold at top — first, as warm-up.

exercises.name: Assisted partial negatives
exercises.variant: lower to elbow ~90° only, feet on box or band
exercises.cue: First rep of each set: hold 3–5s at the top before lowering — this is the screen. Shaky or front-of-shoulder pain → stop.
exercises.raw: Assisted partial negatives: 4×3 — from top, lower to elbow ~90° ONLY, 5s, then step off.

exercises.name: Inverted rows
exercises.cue: Negatives are this week's pull lever.
exercises.raw: Inverted rows, pronated: 4×8, 2s pause at chest — same angle.

exercises.name: Reverse snow angels
exercises.raw: Reverse snow angels: 3×12, 0.5L bottles.

exercises.name: Right-arm curl
exercises.raw: Right-arm curl: 3×8, 3s/3s, 7kg.

exercises.name: Left-arm curl
exercises.raw: Left-arm curl: 3×6, 9kg.

exercises.name: Tricep extension
exercises.raw: Tricep extension: as Day 1.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raises
exercises.raw: Hanging knee raises: 3×8, slow, no swing — replaces floor leg raises.

exercises.name: Hollow body
exercises.raw: Hollow body, weighted: 3×30s, same load as Day 1.

days.notes: Norwegian 4×4. Priority run. Target: 4:10/km, all four reps, within ~5s of each other. Rep 1 ceiling 4:15. Wk14 was 4:04 / 4:42 / 4:17 / 4:18 — the set does not move up on an uneven session, regardless of average.

exercises.name: Warm-up
exercises.raw: 10–12 min warm-up, easy → moderate.

exercises.name: Norwegian 4×4
exercises.cue: RPE 8, no full sentences, not a sprint. Rain cuts it → drop a rep, keep interval length.
exercises.raw: 4 rounds: 4 min @ 90–95% HRmax (RPE 8, no full sentences, not a sprint) / 3 min easy JOG.

exercises.name: Cooldown
exercises.raw: 5 min cooldown. Work at intensity: 16 min.

days.notes: 90/90 hip, cat-cow, wrist circles, shoulder dislocates — full range now if pain-free.

exercises.name: Walk
exercises.raw: Day 7 (Wed) — Active Recovery | 30 min walk + mobility
